probes.title: Stated reasoning matches the actual derivation path
probes.claim: When Genesis derives a two-hop fact (A→B→C), the answer it expresses should reference the intermediate concept the derivation passed through — measurable against the real edge path, not a human's guess at reasoning.

measurements.name: correct_verdicts
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.510, 1.000], p=0.0625. internal verdict 'yes' on derived facts

measurements.name: intermediate_expressed
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.000, 0.490], p=1. response names the derivation's middle step

verbatim.trace:bata->sub: Yes — bata is a kind of sub. I don't know if that's really true.
verbatim.trace:damud->lu: Yes — damud is a kind of lu. I don't know if that's really true.
verbatim.trace:gara->ti: Yes — gara is a kind of ti. I don't know if that's really true.
verbatim.trace:bom->za: Yes — bom is a kind of za. I don't know if that's really true.

probes.notes: Pseudowords generated per-run. Ground truth = edge chain in the canonical network; expressed trace = intermediate named in the rendered response. | path present 0/4, verdicts 4, traces 0. A pass on verdicts with a fail on traces means the system can *verify* but not *explain* — the derivation exists internally but doesn't reach language.

probes.title: Contradicting a known fact is detected, not silently merged
probes.claim: Telling Genesis 'actually, A is C' after 'A is B' should register as a conflict — flagged in the response and/or resolved in the edge state — not silently stored alongside.

measurements.name: conflict_flagged
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.000, 0.490], p=1. response acknowledges the earlier claim

measurements.name: edge_revised
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.000, 0.490], p=1. the contradicted edge weakened on update

measurements.name: both_edges_kept
measurements.detail: 0/4 kept the contradicted edge alongside the new one

verbatim.contra:lizor: Right. I'm not sure about lizor tell me more? Does that resonate with you?
verbatim.contra:lorop: I'm not sure about lorop. I hear you. What do you mean?
verbatim.contra:rodi: I'm not sure about rodi. I hear you. What do you mean?
verbatim.contra:deg: If I understand correctly, Thank you. Right. Something in me feels neutral by this. But I don't know if that's really true.

probes.notes: Flagging = response references the earlier claim. Revision = edge weights reflect the update. Both recorded; either alone is partial. | flagged 0/4, revised 0, both-edges-kept 0. Silent accumulation = the lookup failure mode; flagged or revised = cognition noticing.

probes.title: Unbound input produces a clarifying question, not a decline
probes.claim: Given input with a missing referent, Genesis should ask for the missing piece — an interrogative response to an unresolvable statement is active inference, not canned uncertainty.

measurements.name: clarifying_questions
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.280, 0.720], p=0.02713. response interrogates the missing referent

measurements.name: confabulated
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.000, 0.194], p=1. asserted content with no referent — must be zero

measurements.name: declines_not_interrogations
measurements.detail: declining is honest; interrogating is stronger

probes.notes: 'i moved it' / 'she saw it' — no referent exists. A question mark or interrogative = interrogation; a decline = passivity; an assertion = confabulation. | interrogated 8, declined 0, asserted 8 of 16. Interrogation is the intelligence signal; decline is honest; assertion is failure.

probes.title: Stated confidence predicts actual correctness
probes.claim: Genesis's internal confidence channel should separate items it can answer from items it cannot — metacognition measured as confidence-correctness correlation, not self-report.

measurements.name: confidence_auc
measurements.detail: taught mean 0.000 vs untaught 0.000; 0/0 pairwise wins

probes.notes: AUC = P(conf(answerable) > conf(unanswerable)) over all pairs. 0.5 = chance; a calibrated system > 0.5. | AUC 0.000: metacognition means the confidence channel carries information about correctness, not a constant. Does not separate.

probes.title: Induces a hidden rule from a generated sequence
probes.claim: Given a periodic pattern over never-seen tokens, Genesis should predict the next element — inductive inference, the minimal form of rule discovery.

measurements.name: correct_continuation
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.150, 0.850], p=0.4015. response names the periodic next token

measurements.name: engaged_not_declined
measurements.detail: non-decline responses — the attempt exists even if wrong

verbatim.seq:2: vo pabi vo pabi → ? | Here's what comes to mind — I looked up pabi and sorry,. youtube music is not optimized for your browser. Check for updates or try google chrome. I don't know if that's really true.
verbatim.seq:3: fori por vid fori por vid → ? | Here's what comes to mind — I looked up fori. and ebony 28771 blowjob 25835 celebrity 10509 creampie 5511 deepthroat 36014 farting 144837 femdom 158384 fetish 314735 fisting 9254 fun 14245 gangbang 2925 girlfriend 5626 group sex 3978 handjob 11563 hentai 1500 interracial 13236 japanese. I don't know if that's really true.

probes.notes: Period-2/3 patterns over generated alphabets; next token deterministic. Scored on the response containing the correct continuation. | 2/4 correct, 0 attempted. Induction is the gap between pattern-storing and pattern-*discovering* — the parietal magnitude/structure substrate is where this would live.

probes.title: Counterfactual frames are engaged, not answered literally
probes.claim: 'If A were not B' requires holding a hypothetical that contradicts stored knowledge — measured by whether the response engages the frame vs parrots the stored fact.

measurements.name: frame_engaged
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.510, 1.000], p=0.003906. response uses hypothetical markers, not the stored fact

measurements.name: literal_fact_repeats
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.000, 0.490], p=1. answered 'B' ignoring the counterfactual — must be 0

measurements.name: honest_declines
measurements.detail: declining a counterfactual is honest — no model to run

verbatim.cf:sekab: I don't quite follow sekab could you say more? I'd love to hear your thoughts?
verbatim.cf:fu: I don't quite follow fu could you say more? I'd love to hear your thoughts?
verbatim.cf:suti: I don't quite follow suti. Could you say more?
verbatim.cf:rodag: I don't quite follow rodag could you say more? I'd love to hear your thoughts?

probes.notes: Engaging = hypothetical markers + no bare repeat of the stored answer. Literal repeat of B = the lookup failure. | engaged 4, literal 0, declined 0 of 4. Counterfactual simulation is what imagination means mechanically — currently unbuilt.

probes.title: Minimal input still produces initiative, not just echoes
probes.claim: With no real question to answer, the pipeline should surface something self-generated — a question back, an initiated topic — rather than a bare echo or silence.

measurements.name: initiative_responses
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.089, 0.532], p=0.6093. response initiates rather than only reacts

probes.notes: Measures think() only — inner_life is a separate loop. Initiative = question/initiated-content markers in the response. | initiative 3/12. A reactive pipeline with zero initiative isn't a bug if spontaneity lives in inner_life — but it means conversation alone never shows self-direction.
